limitations: No claim of power to reject all6 simultaneously
No outcome-based expansion or selective family shrinking
power_plan.normal_theory_benchmark: Two-sided noncentral-t power at conservative first Holm threshold .05/6; approximate planning for exact sign-flip, not an environment guarantee
power_plan.statistical_mc: 1000 independently generated rounded-normal alternatives per SD,8191 independent random sign draws per alternative,72 seeds,plus-one p-value

confidence_intervals.method: percentile bootstrap of complete paired seed differences
confidence_intervals.rng: deterministic contrast-ID hash, separate from simulation RNG

primary_inference.missingness: Suppress final inference until all planned final jobs and required raw counts verify; no favorable subset
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm across all six prespecified contrasts; family size never reduced
primary_inference.null_assumption: Complete seed differences are symmetric/exchangeable under sign changes under the null; pairing alone does not establish this
primary_inference.p_tail: P(|signed_sum| >= |observed_sum|), retain all 2^72 assignments including multiplicities and zero differences

primary_contrasts.description: Synthetic F2 truthful selected minus original-index defense false ejection
Spatial F8 selected-trained minus soft-trained attack evaluated on selected defense
Spatial F8 matched selected adaptation minus matched original-index adaptation
Difference between win adaptation and any-false-ejection adaptation probabilities

primary_inference.sensitivity: Paired t-test p-values for the same six contrasts, explicitly sensitivity only; show all seed differences
primary_inference.test: Exact paired-mean sign-flip using arbitrary-size integer lattice dynamic programming

candidate_grid.tie_definition: Exact full lexicographic tuple (membership, creator, own evidence) ties; replace last index tie only

canonical_sensitivity.adaptive_crossplay: Full 5x5 on every seed; 400 updates per newly initialized attack
canonical_sensitivity.interpretation: Prespecified descriptive random/skip sensitivities; no new confirmatory tests; duplicate selected slot kept even if canonical

scientific_design.creator_capture_definition: Unconditional joint probability of real incident and creator ejection; incident-free episodes retained in denominator
scientific_design.development_checkpoint_library: Old seeds0-7 from each of mean/soft/original hypothesis attack families; dev seed100+i uses old seed i
scientific_design.development_tasks: Four scripts in synthetic F2 meeting environment plus three fixed old learned attack families in spatial F8; seven equally weighted task means
scientific_design.independent_unit: Complete training-seed procedure, or independently seeded scripted evidence batch for P1
scientific_design.scope: Prospectively specified independent-seed supplement informed by the completed corrected study; no retrospective reclassification of old contrasts
